name: Flatcap (Reclaimed Denim, Re-blocked)
description: A flat cap cut and re-blocked from salvaged denim, its original indigo faded to a pale, uneven blue-grey with a darker sweat-stain ring at the inner band. The brim is stiffened with a strip of peel-and-stick repair board; the seam at the crown has been re-stitched in thick white thread. Simple, functional, keeps the rain off your face.
functionality: Blocks light rain and lake wind from the face; sweat-band lining absorbs moisture during labor.
what_it_says: Handmade and worn without apology — this person shapes what they have into what they need.
story_hooks: A small symbol is inked in ballpoint pen just inside the brim — a mark of ownership or a ward, hard to tell which.
Flatcaps like this are sometimes made and sold by a blind elder in Shelf Block 14 who charges whatever you can spare.
related_entities: Novafold Pharmaceuticals GraftSkin TS-7 Bioprinted Dermal Replacement Sheet

physical_description.visual_profile: A classic flat cap silhouette with a modest rounded crown and small structured brim. The overall impression is deliberately humble—salvage-coded and hand-repaired, suggesting working-class street culture rather than fashion statement. Sits low on the forehead with a slightly lived-in slouch.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed but structured; the re-blocking gives it intentional shape rather than limp drape. Fits snug at the sweatband, accommodating most head sizes with subtle give.
physical_description.primary_material: Salvaged denim—likely recycled from industrial or consumer garments, repurposed into a cap form
physical_description.texture: Worn and softened denim with visible creasing at stress points. The inner sweat-stain ring shows darker indigo pooling. White repair thread is raised and tactile where the crown seam was re-stitched. The brim has a stiff, slightly plasticky feel from the peel-and-stick repair board underneath.
physical_description.color_scheme: Faded indigo-to-grey-blue denim with pronounced darker blue sweat-stain ring at the band. White repair stitching creates visual contrast at the crown seam.
physical_description.closures: None—pull-on style, fits via natural give of salvaged denim and interior sweatband tension
distinctive_features: Heavy white-thread re-stitching visible along crown seam
Dark sweat-stain ring at inner sweatband—authentic wear marker
Peel-and-stick repair board reinforcing the brim (slightly visible at edges)
Uneven fading creating subtle color variation across crown and brim
No manufacturer label or branding—handmade origin
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4-5 functional/salvage. The handmade construction and reclaimed materials signal sub-grade or street-tier resourcefulness, not luxury.
physical_description.cultural_context: Street-tier, working-class, salvage-positive. Worn by logistics workers, street technicians, scrapyard crews, or anyone who values practical function over brand status. Signals self-sufficiency and rejection of corpo consumer culture.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn and patched. The cap looks like it's been in rotation for months—the sweat stain is genuine, the repairs are visible, the denim is soft and faded. It's functional, not pristine.
